title: For Candidates — Jobs Come to You with Hiron.AI | ON3 Works
markdown:
— FOR CANDIDATES · POWERED BY HIRON.AI

# Jobs come to _you._

Stop chasing roles. ON3 Works contacts candidates through [Hiron.AI](https://hiron.ai/)— our AI Agent actively works on your behalf, matching your profile with the right opportunities and bringing them straight to you.

[Join Hiron.ai →](https://hiron.ai/)

● LIVE · YOUR AI AGENT

"Found a Staff Backend role in London matching your stack. Interested?"

VIA WHATSAPP · 09:42

— INDEX 01 · YOUR CHALLENGES

## Job hunting is broken.  _You deserve better._

— 01

The Resume Black Hole

Spending hours applying to dozens of companies, only to be met with total silence or automated rejection emails.

— 02

Endless Customization

Constantly tweaking your CV and writing custom cover letters for every single application, draining your time and energy.

— 03

Missed Opportunities

Missing out on your dream role simply because you couldn't scroll through job boards 24/7 or didn't use the exact keywords a manual screener was looking for.

— INDEX 02 · OUR SOLUTION

## Your personal _24/7 AI recruiter._

Imagine having a dedicated career advocate working for you around the clock. Our AI actively matches your true potential and preferences with the right recruiters.

Ⅰ.

A Dynamic, Living Profile

Submit your CV just once. Our AI intelligently adapts and highlights your strengths for the best opportunities, eliminating the need for endless customization on your end.

Ⅱ.

Always-On Job Hunting

While you work, sleep, or relax, your AI agent is analyzing the market, ensuring you get maximum visibility for the roles that genuinely fit your skills.

Ⅲ.

Upload & Connect

Drop your CV on our platform and instantly connect with your new AI agent via WhatsApp. It's that simple to get started.

Ⅳ.

You Are Always in Control

Get notified via WhatsApp when a company is interested. You have total freedom: opt-in to accept the introduction and move forward, or opt-out if the role doesn't feel right. No pressure, ever.

— ROLES

## Our AI is actively looking to match you with the _right roles._

[Join Hiron.ai →](https://hiron.ai/)

We use Google Ads cookies to measure which ads bring enquiries. Without your consent we set no cookies; if you came from one of our ads, Google gets a cookieless signal unless you reject.
